message.content: {"question": "Knowing that the mass of a planet is M = 5.98 · 10²⁶ kg and the radius is R = 6.37 · 10⁶ m, calculate the escape velocity vₑ of a body from the planet.", "options": {"A": "vₑ = 1.11 · 10³ m/s", "B": "vₑ = 1.11 · 10⁴ m/s", "C": "vₑ = 1.11 · 10⁵ m/s", "D": "It is not possible to answer because the mass of the body is not known"}, "correct": "B"}
